column_description: BIGSERIAL. Unique identifier for the thermal, solar, wind, and grid record. PK.
BIGINT. Reference to the communication record. FK to Communication.COMM_ID.
BIGINT. Reference to the battery record. FK to PowerBattery.PWR_BATT_ID.
TEXT. Thermal image status. Possible values: Critical, Normal, Warning.
TEXT. Insulation status. Possible values: Fair, Good, Poor.
REAL. Heat loss in kilowatt-hours. **NULL means no heat loss data recorded.**. Example: 1.11.
TEXT. Solar panel status. Possible values: Active, Fault, Inactive.
REAL. Solar panel output in watts. Example: 746.1.
REAL. Solar efficiency percentage. Example: 2.0.
REAL. Solar panel temperature in Celsius. Example: -14.9.
TEXT. Wind turbine status. Possible values: Fault, Operating, Stopped.
REAL. Wind turbine output in watts. **NULL means no wind output data recorded.**. Example: 656.8.
BIGINT. Wind turbine RPM. Example: 130.3.
TEXT. Power grid status. Possible values: Connected, Disconnected, Island Mode.
REAL. Power quality index. Example: 95.
TEXT. Backup power status. **NULL means no backup power status recorded.**. Possible values: Active, Fault, Standby.
TEXT. Fuel cell status. Possible values: Fault, Operating, Standby.
REAL. Fuel cell output in watts. Example: 185.0.
REAL. Fuel cell efficiency percentage. Example: 48.2.
REAL. Hydrogen level percentage. Example: 95.
REAL. Oxygen level percentage. Example: 82.
